infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to your photo library to upload media files and save QR codes.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to your camera to take photos for products and QR codes.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app needs access to your microphone to record audio files.
infoPlist.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: This app needs access to your documents to upload media files.
infoPlist.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: This app needs access to your downloads folder to upload media files.
infoPlist.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: This app needs access to your music library to provide enhanced media playback features.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: This app uses motion data to enhance media playback controls.
